answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch; standing accrues only from audited work co-signed by already-established peers rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. A verifier passes every endorsement through a prism: vouches sharing one root overlap and cancel instead of stacking, so a sybil fleet forked from one wallet merely mirrors its own key back onto itself and never spans distinct clusters. Honest agents spread like yarrow from many real roots, so 100 fakes cost 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
